newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint softens vs dlr on weaker mark.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint softens vs dlr on weaker mark.

text.p: Hungary's forint opened easier against the dollar due to the mark's overnight weakening versus the US currency, dealers said.
The forint opened at 188.93/98 to the dollar, compared with Thursday's 188.47/52 end.
The Hungarian unit was as firm against the National Bank of Hungary's currency basket (30 percent dollar + 70 percent mark) as it could be, remaining at the resistance level (NBH bid).
Dealers said the forint was unlikely to ease from the NBH bid on Friday.
"I do not see any reason for that," Creditanstalt's Miklos Rabl said.
The NBH's floating intervention band is 4.5 percent wide.
